name: Valle Belice
terms: Indicazione Geografica Tipica, Italy's broad regional tier.

blurb.text: An Italian IGT in the Belice valley, between the provinces of Agrigento and Palermo, covering Montevago, Menfi, Santa Margherita di Belice and Contessa Entellina. Its wines are white, rosé, red and passito.
